failed.reason: Extraction failed (rc=1) — ScienceDirect requires JavaScript rendering. Open-access content is not accessible via static extraction. No DOI redirect found to alternative host.

gaps_attempted.notes: Component-level power specs obtained: individual PZT transducers at 28–40 kHz rated at 50 W with coupling factor Kp ≥ 55%. For reactor scale, number of transducers would scale with desired acoustic intensity and vessel geometry — neither of which has a design basis for this concept. The key missing data point (electroacoustic wall-plug efficiency at system level) was not found in accessible sources; best available proxy is the manufacturer's coupling factor spec. The high-value ScienceDirect review paper is open-access but inaccessible to the extraction tool.

gaps_attempted.notes: Gap addressed: 2023 UN Comtrade data (via World Bank WITS) gives implied export prices of ~$459/kg (India) and ~$475/kg (Canada) — the two dominant D2O producers. Market report data from search results (not extracted) shows $646–$680/kg ex-factory in 2024–2025. Both are consistent with and refine the analysis's existing $700/kg rough estimate. The WITS source provides an authoritative, citable World Bank data point.
